coverage.domain: project validation and first-slice capability gate

source.check: The runner's own first-slice checks (studio/openmc_studio/headless.py, test/test_headless.py) refuse the same faults.
source.text: An eigenvalue project with 25 active batches (25 batches, none inactive). The runner runs eigenvalue cases but refuses fewer than 30 active batches (MCNP 6.3 manual 2.8.3.2): the k-eff of such a run is too noisy to judge convergence by. Before 2026-10-25 this entry expected E_UNSUPPORTED (the runner took fixed-source cases only).
